Stock market news | SEBI approves IPO papers of 8 companies including Sterlite Electric

SEBI has given IPO approval to eight companies, allowing them to proceed with public issues. The cleared companies include Sterlite Electric, Svatantra Microfin, Gaurik Fashions, Emerald Jewel Industry India, Beauty Garage, Noble Hygiene, MP Steel, and Kataria Dhulchand Pannalal Jewellers.
